The viewport is 500px wide and 300px tall. `root>lower` has a bounding box of `x=0 y=700 width=400 height=40`, so it fits horizontally within 0–500 and sits below the current view; vertical scrolling can move it up to fully fit in the viewport (its height is only 40px). By contrast, `root>sideways` has `x=0 y=40 width=900 height=40`, so it extends to 900px wide while the viewport is only 500px; ordinary scrolling can’t bring the entire node into view without horizontal scrolling.

ANSWER: root>sideways
